## Description

#### What type of PR is this?
/kind cleanup

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
`newTASFlavorSnapshot` will most likely require a new optional parameter to be passed to it (`schedulingSnapshot`, https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12256).

To not pollute the call with multiple `nil` values, we can introduce the variadic options pattern to the constructor: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12256#discussion_r3413774663

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
Fixes #

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
The code and test changes were generated with Gemini.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?
```release-note
NONE
```

## Walkthrough

`newTASFlavorSnapshot` is refactored from accepting a direct `tolerations []corev1.Toleration` parameter to using a functional-options pattern. A new `tasFlavorSnapshotOptions` struct, `tasFlavorSnapshotOption` type, and `withTolerations` function are introduced. The constructor now clones tolerations from the options. All call sites in production and test code are updated accordingly.

## Changes

**Tolerations functional-options refactor**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Functional-options implementation and production call site** <br> `pkg/cache/scheduler/tas_flavor_snapshot.go`, `pkg/cache/scheduler/tas_flavor.go`|Adds `tasFlavorSnapshotOptions`, `tasFlavorSnapshotOption`, and `withTolerations`; updates `newTASFlavorSnapshot` to accept `opts ...tasFlavorSnapshotOption` and clone tolerations from options; updates `TASFlavorCache.snapshot` to pass `withTolerations(c.flavor.Tolerations)`.|
|**Test call site updates** <br> `pkg/cache/scheduler/tas_flavor_snapshot_test.go`, `pkg/cache/scheduler/tas_balanced_placement_test.go`|Removes trailing `nil` argument from `newTASFlavorSnapshot` calls in snapshot tests; replaces `nil` with `[]string{}` in balanced-placement tests to match the new variadic signature.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~5 minutes

</details>
